data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact's mechanism (integer-factor scaling: 21 = 3×7, cost = 3×$2) is not a primitive fact but REDUCES TO the uniform-rate covering principle of SRC_002: the factor-of-three argument is valid only because the constant unit rate $2/7 per pencil is scale-invariant, and integer grouping is a special case that inherits the linear model's proportionality. Refuted if 21×$2/7 can be shown to diverge from 3×$2 under some non-pathological reassociation of the arithmetic, or if the grouping derivation produces the correct value $6 while the unit-rate derivation does not (which would sever the reduction).
